Grafana is often used to visualize data collected by Prometheus, further supporting the monitoring and observability capabilities of the system.

Agile Methodologies are a core skill for developers, and a component of their skillset

Effective communication is crucial for a DevOps Engineer to collaborate with development teams and stakeholders.
Time management is a vital skill for a DevOps Engineer to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Problem-solving skills are crucial for troubleshooting issues and optimizing DevOps processes.
